name: web-dark-crm-dashboard-on-monitor-silhouette-cover
title: Dark CRM Dashboard Cover with Silhouette
whatItIs: A cover with a desktop monitor showing a dark relationship-management dashboard, a person's silhouette at the right and dark grey shading around.
whatItMeans: The dark room and lit screen create a focused, professional mood, as if seen at night. The silhouette adds human context.
techniques: Lit screen as the only bright object in a dark scene
Human silhouette at the frame edge for scale
Monochrome scene with a tiny green accent

vocabulary.definition: A display glowing in an otherwise dark composition.
A figure shown only as a dark outline.
Edges darkened to focus the centre.
